id: title:jurajmajerik:keep metric validation errors out of error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed exception handling and conditional error classification in Temporal workflow recalculation, potentially excluding transient validation errors from PostHog's error tracking while retaining permanent failures.
review.reason: Adds a new exception class and its parent, along with a conditional check to distinguish between transient and permanent errors. This could allow PostHog to exclude transient validation errors from its error tracking while retaining permanent failures. However, the complete implementation and benefit cannot be established.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the full implementation of the new exception class or the activity interceptor that consumes the marker, so the complete mechanism and PostHog benefit cannot be established.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the full implementation of the new exception class or the activity interceptor that consumes the marker, so the complete mechanism and PostHog benefit cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception class NonReportableApplicationError and its parent NonReportableError, and a constant MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_CHARS.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a typed, non-reportable exception for Temporal workflow failures, potentially excluding certain failures from PostHog's error tracking.

observations.behavior: Imports the new exception class into the recalculation logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the recalculation activity to use the new exception type.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check to raise NonReportableApplicationError for validation errors, while retaining ApplicationError for permanent errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Distinguishes validation errors from permanent errors, potentially excluding the former from PostHog's error tracking while retaining the latter.
